## Legal: a contract-review hub with a custom agent


Legal teams build a review hub where a custom AI agent reads contracts and applies their standards, while the team keeps every judgment call. In[Taskade Genesis](https://www.taskade.com/agents) , you create a legal agent, train it on your case documents, statutes, and style guide, and then drop contracts into the project to get structured analysis back.


How a non-technical legal operator uses it:


- **Upload** a contract or memo into the project editor (PDF, DOCX, or text).
- **Run the agent** with a slash command to apply citation standards (like Bluebook), summarize the court's reasoning, and flag clauses worth a closer look.
- **Refine arguments** by asking the agent to play opposing counsel — a mock trial that surfaces weak points before they cost you.
- **Keep everything** in one searchable hub: precedents, statutes, and drafts all live beside the agent that reads them.


The agent uses built-in tools and routes across frontier models from top AI labs — so it can search, read files, and reason without you switching apps. The outcome: routine document work moves faster while expert analysis stays human. Start from a[legal agent](https://www.taskade.com/agents/legal) and adapt it to your firm.

What the app does for a class or a single student:


- **Organizes coursework** into folders by subject, with notes captured in whichever of the views fits the material (Mind Map for concepts, Table for reading lists, Calendar for the semester).
- **Tracks assignments** with due dates and automated reminders, so nothing slips before a deadline.
- **Runs group projects** with real-time collaboration — classmates view, edit, and contribute at once, with role-based access.
- **Powers a tutor agent** that summarizes lectures, generates practice questions, and explains hard concepts on demand.


The outcome: courses stay organized and recall improves, because the study material and the AI that quizzes you live in the same place. Educators can publish the hub with a[custom domain](https://www.taskade.com/wiki/genesis/custom-domains) and built-in sign-in so a whole cohort can join.
